name: One hybrid teacher, its native thinking and non-thinking distributions, distilled at D4-Augmented's training scale under the target-position Top-200 + tail KD protocol
status: DESIGNED 2026-10-28 at $0 on the maintainer's decision; revised 2026-10-29 on the maintainer's brief 'Research A First, Research B Teacher Selection Deferred' (Research A runs first and alone; its tasks built and frozen; its execution chain complete); hardware and execution revised 2026-10-29 on the maintainer's brief 'Research A L40S-First Hardware and Budget Correction' (L40S by default; nothing scientific changed). NOT FROZEN: frozen with its preregistration when the maintainer grants the phase. Authorizes nothing.
decided_by: maintainer brief 2026-10-28 'Revised Research A/B Programme & Engineering Principles', sections 3 and 5; maintainer brief 2026-10-29 sections 3 and 4; maintainer brief 2026-10-29 'Research A L40S-First Hardware and Budget Correction', sections 1-6 (hardware, execution, storage and budget only)

supersedes.study: stage2.teacher_modes.hybrid_v1 (configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/design.json, sha256 bound in the A-E grant)
supersedes.what_changes: the scale (D4-Augmented's order of magnitude instead of T0's 1,761 tasks), the KD objective (the project's new training baseline), and no promotion pilot (the 10% A1 slice is cancelled); the mode protocol, token protocol, isolation, admission, initialization and evaluation are carried over unchanged
supersedes.historical: hybrid_v1's design, A-E's PASS (ae_20261028_093428) and every record of it stay as they are

question: With one hybrid teacher, one student architecture, one common initialization and one recovery recipe, does distilling the teacher's native THINKING distribution or its native NON-THINKING distribution give a small student better fluid-reasoning correctness on unseen problems -- (S) on the same tasks, and (C) at comparable training compute -- at D4-Augmented's training scale?

teacher.lineage_note: a different post-training lineage from Thinking-2507 (D4-Augmented's and Research B's teacher): no Research A student is ever set beside a Research B student as a controlled pair, even under the same KD objective

H-T.targets: every generated token: <think>, the reasoning, </think>, the answer and the stop token

H-N.targets: every generated token: the answer and the stop token; the template's empty think block is context

modes.switch: the official hard switch only (apply_chat_template(..., enable_thinking=...)); no /think or /no_think, no hand-built prefix, no mode-inducing system text; the system message 'You are a helpful Assistant.' for both modes and every task that carries none
modes.verified: A-E PASS (ae_20261028_093428): prompt token identity, both modes' generation, think states and stop tokens on the real teacher under vLLM 0.27.1

token_protocol: unchanged from hybrid_v1: a document is the engine's own prompt_token_ids followed by its own output_token_ids (aadistill.data.token_documents); nothing re-rendered; every document's prompt ends in its mode's generation prompt; only stop-terminated generations become documents; multi-turn episodes admitted whole, one document per turn

scale.reference: D4-Augmented's training scale (h1pa.json :: arms.D4-Augmented.schedule): 5,923,021 supervised tokens, 2,468 packed sequences of 8,192, batch size 2, 3 epochs, 3,702 optimizer steps, two seeds
scale.target: the H-T-S arm reaches D4-Augmented's packed-sequence count, 2,468 isolated 8,192-token sequences, and therefore its optimizer-step count; supervised tokens follow from the teacher's own documents and are reported, never forced to 5,923,021
scale.S_arms_differ: H-N-S trains on the same task ids and is smaller (non-thinking documents are shorter): its sequence and step counts are what its documents pack to, and the compute difference is reported beside S
scale.never: lengthening, shortening, re-sampling or re-scoring a teacher generation to reach a number; lowering a correctness standard; repeating tasks to inflate the independent-task count

tasks.T0: the frozen H1 task lists (hybrid_v1 :: tasks.T0: P1 1,587 + P1t 59 + PA1 115 = 1,761 tasks, sha256-pinned), both modes

E._: the D4-scale extension, both modes on every task
E.source: the order data/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/tasks/order_v1.jsonl (build_tasks.py), T0's (stratum, source) cells in T0's proportions by largest remainder: each cell's unused pool tasks first, round-robin over its groups (P1's rule), then new tasks from the SAME source's own construction (the project generators on a fresh seed block inside R5's training range; the third-party generators through H1's isolated export at new seed bases; MATH, MBPP and SQuAD v2 continued in their pool builder's hash order). A cell whose supply ends hands its later share to its stratum's other cells (MBPP, 474 tasks in all, runs out at order position 4,948, inside X); no stratum's share moves
E.built_before_generation: FROZEN 2026-10-29 at $0 before any of its tasks is generated: 17,762 tasks (V 240, E 3,522 = 2 x T0, X 14,000), sha256 d71ac56b99f3..., R0-R9 pass with 17 flagged items removed first (R1/R2/R7 and the calibration prompts' keys); per-slice stratum shares within 0.24 points of T0's in V, equal in E, within 0.01 in X (order_v1.manifest.json)
E.order: the frozen order's E slice in waves of 400 (W01..W09)

tasks.stopping_rule: after each wave (W00 = T0 and V first) the admitted H-T documents of I are packed document_isolated at 8,192; the stopping wave is the first whose pack reaches 2,468 sequences, or the last of E (the reached count is then the scale, reported). Exact on the dev box with every verifier (admission.py); the pod, which cannot run MBPP's sandbox, bounds the rule from below and keeps generating until its LOWER count reaches the target (generation_protocol.json :: stopping), so it never stops early; waves after the stopping wave are generated and never trained on. A data-size rule fixed before any datum exists, never a scientific decision

X.rule: X's H-N-admitted tasks, taken in X's order per stratum and interleaved by largest remainder against I's stratum shares, added whole until H-N-C's isolated pack reaches H-T-S's sequence count; then the smallest such prefix
X.independence: every X task is a distinct task (a distinct pool item or a distinct generator seed); no task, prompt or content key repeats across T0, E, X or eval-set-1
X.if_infeasible: C is FEASIBLE when that count is reached and every stratum's share of H-N-C's tasks is within 2 points of its share of I (admission.py); otherwise the registered fallback (preregistration :: comparisons.C.fallback), decided at $0 on the dev box before any training

V._: the validation reserve: the order's first 240 tasks, generated with T0 in W00 in both modes, never trained on
V.use: each mode's admitted V documents packed document_isolated, at most 16 sequences: every arm's validation CE/KD in its own mode (diagnostics only, never a decision)

generation.runner: teacher_session.py (teacher_modes) on H1's generation driver (run_group, sealed shards, second_pass) and run_battery.py --mode generate under each mode's template kwargs and official sampling (H-T 0.6/0.95/20/0, H-N 0.7/0.8/20/0), every value read from generation_protocol.json; the same recorded seed for the same (task, candidate, turn) in both modes; up to 2 candidates per task, the second only when the pod's pure-Python verdict rejects the first (none for MBPP)
generation.allowance: per turn, 8,184 - the prompt's tokens: a document never exceeds the 8,192-token training sequence, so nothing is ever cut

long_reasoning._: the maintainer's concern (brief section 5): thinking trajectories longer than the training sequence
long_reasoning.rule: a turn that reaches its allowance (8,184 - the prompt) without a stop token is recorded length_limited: TRAINING-LENGTH-LIMITED and right-censored at the training sequence, never a context-limit hit (the teacher's supported context is 40,960) -- never admitted, never truncated into a document, never scored as wrong
long_reasoning.recorded: per cell, mode and wave: the share of first candidates censored, their prompt lengths, and how many tasks were admitted only through a second candidate; the teacher's eval-set-1 generations at its full supported context (40,960) show the uncensored length distribution beside it
long_reasoning.flag: LENGTH_CENSORED, a DESCRIPTIVE warning threshold (maintainer brief 2026-10-29 section 4): any primary cell whose H-T first-candidate length-limited share exceeds 20% carries it; that cell's length-limited share, correctness, natural-termination rate and trainable-sample count are reported in full beside the composition shift of I. It never drops a capability category, changes admission, pauses anything or triggers a re-run
long_reasoning.declared_bias: admission at 8,192 favours tasks whose thinking fits the sequence; the comparison is between the two modes' admissible teacher-native distributions at this sequence length, and is reported as that

generation.calibration: the hybrid's own H-T and H-N trajectories on the prompts of D4 Top-1's two calibration profiles (calib.s0v_rh_d4@v1, 75, for ATTENTION; calib.s0v_base_d4@v1, 85, for DEPTH, RESIDUAL_WIDTH and FFN), each prompt recovered from its own token ids (hybrid_calibration.py; logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/plans/calibration_inputs), one candidate per mode
generation.persistence: the teacher session writes everything under <volume>/teacher_modes as it completes -- each wave's sealed shards (sha256 markers), the initialization, the teacher's evaluation -- and the launcher pulls every sealed shard and finished evidence on each poll; a later attempt re-reads the volume and never regenerates a sealed shard, re-materializes the initialization or re-evaluates a persisted unit

admission: verified correct by the frozen verifiers (P1v), naturally terminated, every turn within 8,192, the prompt in its mode's generation prompt; units whole; identical rules in both modes. I = tasks admitted in both modes

initialization.rule: ONE common initialization for every arm, compressed from the hybrid teacher itself (unchanged from hybrid_v1)
initialization.method: D4 Top-1's operator path, step for step (its search record: attention.activation_importance_v1 on rh_d4's prompts, depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1, width.global_pca_v0, ffn.activation_importance_v0 on base_d4's; seed 20260815; the Stage-0 search's execution and target geometry), materialized ONCE on Qwen/Qwen3-4B@1cfa9a72 by materialize_fixed_path with the hybrid's own mode-balanced items as two hybrid profiles (initialization.py): operator-internal measurement only, no search, no pinned digest
initialization.geometry: the 596M student geometry (28 layers, 1,024 wide, 16/8 heads, FFN 3,072, tied embedding), inheriting the hybrid's config
initialization.persistence: persisted on the volume the moment it exists (persist_unit) with initialization.json last; its identity is committed (logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/assets/common_initialization.json) and every recovery unit re-identifies it from its bytes; never re-materialized after it exists
initialization.mode_balance: equal scored positions from each mode, by whole items: every item of the mode with fewer, then the other mode's items in a seeded order until its positions reach that total; subtype = source subtype x mode, so DEPTH's subtype-then-domain average weighs the modes equally (calibration.items_from_records)

execution.micro_batch_size: the forward baseline's execution (configs/shared/baselines/selection.json: micro-batch 3, length-sorted packing, scored rows only), DEPTH prefix reuse on, as the Stage-0 search ran it
execution._on_out_of_memory: memory management, not a protocol change: on a CUDA out-of-memory error the path is rerun ONCE at micro-batch 1, execution.py's one-item-per-forward reference path -- the same operators, profiles, seed, geometry and estimand, a different grouping of the same forwards (an execution knob, recorded in initialization.json :: execution; never chosen by a result). Why it is declared: DEPTH widens a micro-batch's scored rows to float32 at once, about 12.4-13.0 GiB at micro-batch 3 on 8k-token items (the Stage-0 d4 profiles' largest length-sorted batch: 21,882 / 22,910 rows x 151,936), the regime that ran an L40S out of memory (pilot_20261018_122808); about 4.4 GiB at micro-batch 1. A size that already ran out of memory is never repeated (oom_mb<k>.json on the volume)

arms.H-N-C: H-N documents of I and X, sized to H-T-S's sequence count

objective.kd: the project's training baseline: loss.kd_support resolved from the forward baseline (reference_topk_tail_v1, top_k 200, shared.forward_baseline), loss.kd_scope 'assistant' (= the documents' generated tokens), T 1; the Top-200 + tail KL, never called the full-vocabulary KL
objective.ce: CE 0.25 on the same positions; KD 1.0
objective.positions: token-native documents make the target mask the generated tokens exactly: no system, user, header, template or prefill position is a target (the H-N template's empty think block is context), and under document isolation no position predicts across a document boundary

recovery.as: H1-PA's recipe (h1pa.json :: recipe, E1's configs): batch size 2 packed sequences, micro-batch size 1 (2 gradient accumulation steps on one GPU), sequence length 8,192, 3 epochs, total_steps = ceil(3 x sequences / 2), warmup max(10, round(0.05 T)), AdamW lr 5e-5 betas (0.9, 0.95) eps 1e-8 weight decay 0.01, clipping 1.0, cosine to 0.1, fp32 weights with bf16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, E1's trainable patterns (the tied embedding frozen)

declared_changes_from_h1pa.loss: the training baseline above (H1-PA: full-vocabulary KD at every position)
declared_changes_from_h1pa.val_blocks: each arm's own-mode validation tail (at most 16 sequences)

recovery.identical_across_arms: everything except the training documents and, through them, the step count
recovery.driver: recovery_units.py (teacher_modes): the packs rebuilt on the pod from the volume's shards and the committed admission record, every file's sha256 equal to the record's; then h1pa_driver.run per GPU (state, resume, persistence, evaluation are H1-PA's); each student evaluated in its own mode with the hybrid's tokenizer and template

execution.topology: one GPU per training unit; units of different arms or seeds may run concurrently on separate GPUs of one pod, which changes no unit's arithmetic
execution.hardware: NVIDIA L40S 48 GB for every session and operation of the phase: the engineering check, the calibration generation, the initialization, the waves, X, the teacher's evaluation at 40,960, every recovery unit and every student evaluation. An A100 is used for an operation only when that operation is MEASURED not to fit an L40S after memory management that changes no protocol (execution micro-batch, engine concurrency, activation checkpointing, allocator settings) -- and then for that operation alone, under a separate funding application with the evidence; an unmeasured operation is not evidence of need. Never a shorter sequence, dropped data, a changed batch semantics, a lower evaluation context or another protocol to fit a card. The card, its count and the pod enter every unit's execution identity; every formal unit of one comparison trains on one card type
execution.persistence: save points (optimizer state, step, RNG states, the consumed-sequence position, the bound data and initialization identities) on the network volume as written; a later attempt resumes from the last valid save point, never retrains a completed unit, never re-evaluates a scored one

sessions.check: one L40S, before anything formal: the bounded engineering check (l40s_check.py, phase.py kind check) on diagnostic inputs only -- the teacher session's generation path, the evaluation engine at 40,960, D4 Top-1's fixed path on the hybrid with the Stage-0 profiles, the formal training step; peak allocated/reserved memory, step time, throughput and the free margin (>= 4 GiB wanted). Its committed record is what the teacher session is priced from, and the teacher kind's artifact binds it
sessions.teacher: one L40S: calibration -> initialization -> W00..W09 -> X -> the teacher's evaluation in both modes (phase.py kind teacher; it may run as several sessions by --phases, each resuming from the volume)
sessions.dev_box: admission.py on the secured shards ($0): the exact rules, the packs' sha256, committed with the initialization record
sessions.recovery: one pod, one or two L40S, the six units, one unit per GPU (phase.py kind recovery)

evaluation.set: eval-set-1, every item of every unit, under its registered identity, validity mask and formal protocol v2
evaluation.decoding: nucleus_v1 (912214c6...) for every student and for the teacher in both modes
evaluation.mode: each student in its own training mode; the teacher in both, at its full supported context (P18)
evaluation.scoring: the frozen scorers on records that state their think_state (approved 2026-10-27; tests/test_mode_scoring_conformance.py)
evaluation.axes: AGENTS.md P10.2's four primary axes, each reported apart: task-contained deduction, inductive rule discovery and compositional generalization (eval-set-1's static items, decided) and interactive adaptation and planning (the 144 interactive episodes, exploratory); abstract/analogical reasoning, a registered sub-category, is reported as its own axis and enters the static Holm family as eval-set-1 registers it; every other unit reported beside, never pooled; NLL, KL and usable rollout are never read as reasoning
evaluation.teacher: the teacher in both modes on every item, at the remaining capacity of its 40,960-token supported context (P18), in the teacher session

isolation: task, rule-family, transformation-family, generator and source-lineage isolation between T0, E, X, the calibration prompts and eval-set-1 (R0-R9; shared.eval_sets.require_disjoint and held_out_paths); never an official ARC-AGI evaluation task or a derivative
research_b: Research B's teacher is the maintainer's decision after this study's complete result; nothing here selects it, and no Research B experiment starts automatically from it (brief 2026-10-29)
